messages:
olivia: Hi everyone — first day remote! Quick, who owns the must-fix onboarding things so I don’t start spamming channels: repo perms, SSH/VPN, Vault/KMS tokens, PagerDuty, and Dedicated tenant access?
marc: welcome @olivia! Short map -> repo perms: eng-platform; SSH/VPN + cloud console: eng-infra; Vault/KMS: security-infra; PagerDuty/oncall: eng-sre; Dedicated/customer provisioning: solutions-eng + customer-success.
sofia: Practical tips: 1) repo perms -> perms form (link in handbook) + tag @eng-platform if you need write fast. 2) SSH keys -> upload at /ssh-keys and then open #help if bastion rejects you.
infra-bot: [automated] To request infra credentials include: purpose, duration (if temporary), and service name. Example payload:
```
purpose: onboarding - debug customer dedicated tenant
duration: 4h
service: dedicated-provisioner-staging
```
olivia: Nice. If I get paged and I need to decide whether to page infra vs runtime vs sre, is there a short rule?
marc: Rule of thumb: networking/credentials/storage failures -> eng-infra. Model outputs, wrong version, kv-cache or quantization regressions -> eng-runtime (biz hours). Anything broad customer-impacting or severe alarms -> page eng-sre immediately; they triage and pull others.
sofia: Dedicated customer incidents: always cc customer-success and the account owner. We have a Dedicated runbook (link in handbook) that lists who to ping per account.
devex-bot: [automated reminder] DevEx maintains the canonical who-to-ask matrix. If something is missing, open a quick MR in the onboarding repo and tag @devex. Example link: https://redwood.internal/devex/onboarding/who-to-ask
olivia: Sweet. One last: who should I ping to fast-track a PagerDuty invite? I won’t need production access yet but want to be on the oncall rotation for learning.
marc: Fill the PD invite form and cc your manager; for fast-tracks ping @eng-sre or DM me and we can add you to a non-prod policy for shadowing. Production oncall requires manager approval and a short ramp plan.
olivia: Thanks all — I’ll submit the perms + ssh forms and bookmark the DevEx page. Appreciate the quick map! :raised_hands:
